From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Subject: Critical: manager consolidation & sensitive transition plan (confidential)

Team —

After the leadership review last week I put together a concrete proposal to consolidate two manager-level roles in Platform Ops (Manager, Inference Runtime and Manager, Serving Infra) into a single Manager, Serving & Runtime. The intent is to reduce handoffs, clarify ownership for our runtime-to-serving handover, and free budget toward a senior SRE IC role.

High-level summary (attached):
- Who: consolidation affects 2 manager roles (one voluntary exit anticipated; second role impacted)
- Timeline: target public announcement window = the week of 2026-09-13; confidential HR coordination to start immediately
- Risks: perceived involuntary headcount reduction, morale impact, potential attrition in adjacent pods
- Ask: agree to confidential coordination with People Ops and a drafting of manager-level talking points + 1:1 schedule

I've attached the manager-transition-guidelines.pdf and a consolidation-impact-matrix.xlsx with suggested 1:1 owners and task list. Please review the matrix — it includes recommended who speaks in each 1:1, suggested compensation levers if needed, and an outline for a private HR package if separation is required.

I suggest we keep this thread strictly confidential for now (label: "sensitive-personnel"). If you agree, I will loop in Acme People Ops and our external partner for outplacement support (Hiring Partners) and schedule a 30-minute sync.

Next steps proposed (short):
1) Confirm internal 1:1 owners by EOD 2026-08-23
2) People Ops to prepare compliant language and any paperwork by 2026-08-26
3) Hold manager-only prep call on 2026-08-27

Monica
Monica Patel | Director, Platform People Ops
Redwood Inference

Monica —

Thanks for drafting this. Quick notes after a skim of the matrix:
- I support consolidation in principle but want a clearer picture on the on-call rotation impact for the new combined role (esp. international handover to APAC). Can we add a line item that details expected shift coverage changes?
- On compensation: let's reserve ~$25–35k from the open budget to smooth a voluntary transition package (if needed). We should avoid surprises for the affected manager.
- For comms: agree we keep it tight. Recommend no org-wide mention until after 1:1s are complete.

I'll take the lead on scheduling 1:1s for the serving-side ICs and will send a calendar block today.

-r

Rishi Malhotra | Head of Serving Infrastructure

Also: flag for HR — the manager who has signaled voluntary exit asked for a 30-day flexible leave option in lieu of a straight separation payment. We should evaluate that as an option.
